record.question: What is the main function of FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India)?
options: FSSAI is responsible for monitoring of nutrition in schools
FSSAI ensures safe food practices through regulation and certification.
Monitoring the sale of only packaged foods
Monitoring only the import of fruits and grains
record.explanation: Answer B: FSSAI ensures safe food practices through regulation and certification.. FSSAI sets science-based food standards and regulates manufacture, storage, distribution, sale, and import to ensure safe and wholesome food. Reference: https://fssai.gov.in/cms/about-fssai.php. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
